# S20 — Slicer integration

Add a --ref filter to adj list and adj context so a tool such as slicer can ask adj for the records that reference a slice (adj list --ref S20 --json), with no dependency either way.

## Why

Owner decision 2026-10-18: the adj side of the slicer integration is a --ref filter on adj list and adj context: exact match against a record's refs, repeatable, every --ref given must be among the record's refs; plus a documented recipe (adj list --ref S20 --json). No slicer-side change. Refs exist since S27 (--ref on ask, C171); today only adj check finds them, by substring. The older notes below (dogfood frictions) are already handled by S26-S30 and S34.
